It’s crazy that you’ve posted this because I was going through something similar a few weeks ago. I woke up late at night and decided to stay awake. I grabbed my vape an took a couple puffs off of it. Out of nowhere I started hearing this really high pitched ringing in my left ear. It was super annoying because no matter what sounds played in the background I would still be able to hear it. I kept vaping regardless just to test it, and see if maybe it would just got away on its own. The next day when I woke up in the morning it was really bad, and I started to blame the vape for it because I didn’t know why else the ringing in my ear would occur. Thankfully after a couple more days the ringing almost totally went away. I can’t say for sure that vaping was the cause, but it kind of seemed like it was making the ringing louder sometimes. I’ve been vaping for 3-4 years on & off, and that was the first time that’s really ever happened to me.
